component.name: Eopkg Converter
component.summary: Convert .deb and .rpm packages into Solus .eopkg packages

description.p: Eopkg Converter is a fast, dependency-free tool written in Rust that converts a Debian .deb or an RPM .rpm package into an installable Solus .eopkg package.
It ships two binaries: a command-line converter (eopkg-converter) and a Qt6 graphical interface (eopkg-converter-gui) with batch conversion, a progress bar and a live journal.
The resulting .eopkg is a conformant archive preserving file types, permissions, ownership and symbolic/hard links.
Initial release: DEB and RPM conversion, CLI and Qt6 GUI.
